1879053049.name: Shield of the Dúnedain
1879053049.desc: Spend a considerable amount of your power to shield an ally for a time.

1879086713.name: Seeking Blade
1879086713.desc: Increases the chance that you will critical on Relentless and Remorseless Strikes.

1879097209.name: Squirrel-speech
1879097209.desc: Summons a little squirrel-friend to brighten your day.

1879131129.name: Boar's Rush
1879131129.desc: A fast shield rush deals significant damage to enemies in front of you.

1879146745.name: Vivid Imagery
1879146745.desc: AoE lightning attack that dazes your foes.

1879182841.name: Song of the Hammerhand
1879182841.desc: A Song so potent that it provides you with a shield of morale that must be destroyed before you will begin losing morale again. The name comes from the adage that those who know this song were said to have been able to take a blow from Helm Hammerhand himself.\n\nBubble strength is 35% of your Max Morale pool before other bonuses apply.

1879185145.name: Pale Golden Summer Horse
1879185145.desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879198329.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Mountain Lynx)
1879198329.desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879208441.name: Cave-claw Masked Horse
1879208441.desc: A horse wearing a mask carved from the skull of a cave-claw, discovered while treasure hunting.

1879214585.name: Brink of Victory
1879214585.desc: A potent attack dealing Light Damage to a group of enemies in front of the Warden.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879219449.name: Improved Scathing Mockery
1879219449.desc: Words of heated mockery written to all your foes cause them to burn under your derision.  Apllies Writ of Fire to all effected foes.

1879230329.name: Sudden Maul
1879230329.desc:
With the element of surprise, your mauling attack is even more damaging.

   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased Critical Chance and Critical Damage

Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879240697.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879240697.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline turns your focus toward the tactical ebb and flow of a battle. Your attacks are meant to slow, disable or control the actions taken by your mounted enemies.

1879248377.name: Seeking Arrow - Fire
1879248377.desc: Steadying your mount, you attempt a well-placed shot at an enemy that will deal Fire-based damage and apply a potentially harmful effect to your target.

1879252601.name: Mearas-lore
1879252601.desc: One with nature and the elements the Mearas are adepts at using the natural world against their enemies; as students of nature, beasts and hidden lore so too are Lore-masters who study these wild horses.

1879274105.name: Snap Shot - Hampering Javelin of Light
1879274105.desc: Javelins can pierce body parts or equipment and slow the target until the javelin can be removed.

1879277561.name: Shield-smash
1879277561.desc: Strike a hard blow with your shield, interrupting enemies.\n\n <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires the use of Bash or Shield-taunt.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: \nYour shield skills have a 25% chance to apply a fortification effect that increases your mitigations by 1%. This effect may stack up to five times.

1879301241.name: Muster in Helm's Deep
1879301241.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Helm's Deep in western Rohan.

1879302521.name: Incite Foes
1879302521.desc: You provoke your enemies, forcing them to take notice and attack you.

1879318137.name: Thrash - Tier 2
1879318137.desc: You maul the enemy with your sharp claws. Subsequent attacks deal more damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Each hit of Thrash increases the damage of the Beorning, stacking up to three times.

1879319929.name: Steel Skin
1879319929.desc: Your experience in battle has taught you how to make best use of your armour, which affords you and your steed an increased armour rating.

1879320185.name: Guarded Attack (Dual)
1879320185.desc: Calculated and precise, your attacks hit their mark while bolstering your defences against any retaliation.\n\nThe mitigation buff stacks up to 5 times.

1879390713.name: Steed of Summer's Night
1879390713.desc: A steed dressed to celebrate summer evenings.

1879412857.name: Steed of the Autumn Sage
1879412857.desc: A steed befitting the Leaf-turner themselves.

1879418745.name: Facepaint - Feather
1879418745.desc: Apply facepaint to your cheek with a feather pattern.

1879467257.name: Breath of Ice
1879467257.desc: Breathe a concoction of salt and oil through a torch, causing the very air to freeze and slowing any enemies standing before you.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.

1879470585.name: Folca's Last Stand
1879470585.desc: Sing of Folca's Last Stand against the Everholt Boar.

1879487481.name: Minor Pet Command
1879487481.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879491577.name: Call to the Valar
1879491577.desc: You call upon the wisdom of the Valar, recovering some of your skills and providing a temporary immunity to induction set back from damage.\n\n<rgb=#ecdd11>Ancient Master:</rgb> Storm Lore, Test of Will, Air Lore

1879497721.name: Sign of the Wild: Protection
1879497721.desc: Command your pet to use a defensive ability, prioritizing survival above all else.

1879506553.name: Flame Breath
1879506553.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, breathe a gout of flame in front of you.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

1879506681.name: Wrath of the Righteous
1879506681.desc: Crush and wound your target while also restoring Morale.

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect
